content:
Sophia (AE): FYI — exec escalation for EdgeCorp POC. They report websocket transcript pipeline dropping during spikes. CTO wants either on‑prem or VPC-private deploy + deterministic websocket throughput for live captioning. Exec bridge requested tomorrow 09:00 CET. Need validation ETA + price impact.

Kevin (SE): Got it. Are we talking sustained concurrent websockets or short bursts? Also, which model variant are they planning to run?

Sophia (AE): Customer expects ~600 concurrent websockets, avg payload ~1.2KB, peaks ~1.8KB. Requirements: p99 token latency <120ms for 512-token windows. Plan was our hosted Llama2-13B-ft copy running in their env.

Sam (Infra): Note: our on‑prem package handles wss (websockets over TLS) fine; pure WebRTC/UDP would be a blocker. We need to size a dedicated cluster + per-connection rate limiter. Also need private control plane + BYOK KMS or customer-managed HSM. I'll run a capacity calc and network checklist.

Tina (Platform Eng): Recommend batching with aggressive prefix/KV cache + quantized weights. I can estimate cluster size — likely 4 x A10G nodes per region to start. Need a sample capture or synthetic harness. I can spin up the test harness if we have a connection string.

Kevin (SE): For validation I need a reproducible load script and the exact request pattern (batch vs single-token streaming). Example test we use:
```
# simplified load test invocation
./run_ws_load --url wss://edgecorp.test/ws \n  --concurrency 600 --qps 1000 --payload-size 1200 \n  --model llama2-13b-ft --max-tokens 512
```
Run that against our staging runtime and collect p50/p95/p99 token latencies + drop rate.

Lila (Legal): EdgeCorp flagged CNIL and Schrems II since they operate in FR. They require data residency in France, an SCC/DPA addendum, and confirmation of our subprocessor list. Also asking for SOC2/ISO papers and an export control attestation. Can security/legal confirm feasibility?

Frank (CRO): Pricing question: customer wants a committed reserved cluster for 12 months and asks for a commercial concession (they asked for 35% off + pilot credits). What's our floor on committed discounts and any constraints for on‑prem managed installs?

Tina (Platform Eng): Quick commercial estimate: reserved cluster (4 x A10G) ~ $45k/mo; engineering integration (2 wks) ~ $30k one‑time. We can offer 25% off for a 12‑month commit + 3 months free as a standard package. Any additional infra or compliance work (e.g., HSM attestation) is cost-plus.

Lila (Legal): We can proceed with DPA + SCCs but need time to review customer redlines. On‑prem + BYOK increases risk surface; will require standard indemnities and limitation clauses. I'll draft redline and try to have it ready before the bridge.

Sam (Infra): Network checklist for EdgeCorp: firewall rules, egress peering, allowed FQDNs, certificate chain for control plane. Also need their NOC contact for port mirroring if they want packet captures.

Sophia (AE): Action items before tomorrow's bridge 09:00 CET: Kevin -> provide load harness (EOD), Tina -> capacity plan + cost estimate (EOD), Lila -> DPA redline (EOD), Sam -> network checklist + contact (EOD). @Frank will join the exec bridge.

deploy-bot: Meeting created "EdgeCorp exec bridge" — 2026-03-22 09:00 CET (invites sent).

Frank (CRO): I'll take commercial lead on the bridge. If engineering validates latency and legal signs DPA, I'm comfortable with the 25%/3mo offer; can escalate for extra credits if exec asks.

Kevin (SE): I'll post the harness link in this thread when it's up and attach initial run metrics. Expecting smoke run by 18:00 UTC.

Tina (Platform Eng): I'll also include a short doc with acceptance criteria: p99 token latency <120ms, drop rate <0.5%, successful sustain at 600 concurrent connections for 15 minutes.

Sophia (AE): Great — I will prep the customer agenda and share the bridge link. Will update thread with any pre-bridge asks. :thumbsup:
